entities.summary: Viktorin Kornel of Všehrdy or simply Všehrd, was a Czech humanist and lawyer, working towards the end of the 15th century as Vice-scribe at the Land Court in the Prague Castle. He is known for the most penetrating analysis of the Czech common law that he has put forward on some 460 pages under the title "On the Laws of the Czech Land Nine Books". He has also translated some Latin texts.
